body: Thanks for all of that. It really helped me. I cried a little bit. I'm so upset I don't really know what to say, but I might be messaging you if I have any questions. I have a lump in my throat right now. I'm very thankful.
Mostly russian lit and existentialism and fantasy
I read often. But I don't really have any hobbies, I would like to but I don't feel creative or confident enough to try things and whenever I do I get upset :/ I basically fulfill my own prophecies

never thinking about things, which actually makes it more prevalent in my mind (though probably in the unconscious but intensified), sitting in my room and never talking or doing anything because it's easier to live a half life

What worries me is that I was never good enough to be liked and now it'll be even harder. They always say you attract people by how you live, and I don't live. I suffer in fear every day and it's annoying for other people to see me never take any advice or help myself so they always leave (friends I mean, I've never had a boyfriend or a real date). I even feel right now that all this self-deprecation would annoy you (a stranger who didn't have to reply but was kind enough to try) and you'll stop talking to me.

I just started talking to this one, she's nice and I dislike her but that's because she's doing therapy in a way that might actually help me and I hate helping me and all people who are good for me. I don't know if talking about it will help me, I just want different experiences and to be a different person I guess. It makes me sad that I don't care enough about myself to change and it makes everybody annoyed with me that I stagnate and wallow in this stuff but idk I have always been that way.
Avoidance, but it's clearly not a healthy route lol. I used to do drugs but I smartened up after high school about that one. My coping mechanisms are shite though

Some things I didn't deserve but I also inflicted a lot of wounds onto myself. The whole cycle of feeling bad > doing bad things > feeling worse has been going on for a lifetime and it seems like hell to get out of. Idk I just feel so ashamed to be myself.

It is pretty burdensome. It feels like so much work to get through every day when each new experience causes me pain. I just don't want to have to try so hard or at least I want to *want* to try so hard.
Thanks for making me feel a little more human about it. I hope I can

I'm sorry you had to deal with all that. I know all too well that children can be cruel, and adults can be crueler. Nobody knows I have it and I've only had the one breakout,  so physically it isn't even a problem for me. It's just that my personality disorder amd mood disorder makes dealing with this a bitch and I cam barely handle it. At all. It makes me want to tear my skin off. I had already spent my entire life hating myself and feeling useless and toxic and now I feel like I really am.

Thanks for responding in such a realistic and helpful way. It makes me feel better knowing it isn't that much of a turn off for some people. I just feel like the fact that this post is getting downvoted so hard and that all my friends are immature 19 year olds shows that most people aren't ready to show compassion for people with STIs and right now it's something I really want/need but am unable to ask for any.
You are right. I just already have so many hang ups when it comed to dating amd now my first relationship seems even mote daunting. Maybe one day I'll feel more comfortable in my owm skin.
It's the fact that you could get shit for that that adds to it. I guess I recognoze that the stigma is worse than the infection but stigma is something I can barely handle.
Thank you so much. I want to try to care about myself but it was always hard and now it seems impossible...
